scope: full-2055 g2-apollo-main discarded .text vs stock reachability

method.notes: Used the link map Discarded input sections (equivalent to --print-gc-sections). Mapped addresses from function-name hex suffixes or the immediate Stock/native 0x comment. Reachability from Thumb BL and 4-byte-aligned Thumb pointers in stock.app.bin. Same-TU inlining detected from source call + missing reloc + kept caller. True containers recovered by walking back from the BL to a push-LR prologue.

blestore_reviewed.name: app_ble_comm_state_get_4b8122
blestore_reviewed.resolution: Callers already use audio_ble_controller / the 0x200727f0 block directly and test byte +0x56. Same as the 6-byte getter that returns that address. Equivalent, not a missing call.

blestore_reviewed.name: app_ble_connection_tick_get_4b8204
blestore_reviewed.resolution: audio_ble_ancc_value_update_4befce already subtracts audio_ble_ancc_connection_tick from osKernelGetTickCount and compares to 5000. Same as calling the 12-byte getter. Equivalent.

blestore_reviewed.name: audio_ble_hci_conn_free
blestore_reviewed.resolution: Stock hciCoreConnClose (0x52a762) BL's this; our audio_ble_hci_conn_close is kept at size 0x50, which is the inlined body of conn_free. Classifier pointed at conn_open because close's stock address was a few bytes later. Not a missing call.

blestore_reviewed.name: audio_ble_master_ring_link_event
blestore_reviewed.resolution: Comment parser picked the extern 'native 0x4a1b60' (audio_ble_master_connect_event, kept, size 0x474). This C symbol is the 4-byte 0x4a153c forwarder, and audio_ble_central_emit_ring_link_event_4a153c is already kept.

blestore_reviewed.name: app_slave_reload_resolving_list_4b4720
blestore_reviewed.resolution: 8-byte stock wrapper that only BL's audio_ble_pair_storage_refresh (0x47b4d4). audio_ble_pair_failure_clear already calls storage_refresh directly; that symbol is kept. Equivalent.

blestore_reviewed.name: audio_ble_dm_conn_update_invalid_event_action
blestore_reviewed.resolution: Not the stock function at 0x4b2df8. It is a C helper that reconstructs a 4-byte action table at 0x78eff0 plus the adjacent Thumb pointer 0x004b2df9 (dmDevActReset). dmDevActReset is kept; this helper being GC'd is not a missing call site.

product_c: no edits; all blestore automated hits were inlining, equivalent direct access, or a wrong mapped address
